notes.title: This is Bug - Part 2: More Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Slight performance improvements in some problematic levels.
[*] Fixed a bug in Chapter 2 that caused unwanted sounds.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
(PS: Please stop breaking the game).

notes.title: More bug fixes for "This is Bug".
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player wouldn’t respawn correctly after dying.
[*] Adjusted some dialogue lines that weren’t displaying completely.
[*] Ears in Chapter 2 will now properly die and respawn if ejected.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for playing.

notes.title: More Bug Fixes (When will it end?)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Dying on level 50 after reaching the first checkpoint no longer resets the entire level.
[*] Fixed a ghost platform issue in level 25.
[*] Fixed an issue where custom controls weren’t saved after exiting the control mapper.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to jump over spikes.
[*] Additional minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Update!
notes.content:
-After testing, several minor bugs were identified and fixed.

Thanks for playing!
